subject: build-classes
q: Seventy-four girl records carry coreBuild and fillBuild. v8 retired the Core-and-Fill split entirely, and nobody has said which Native Traits the old Fills become.
detail:
PILLAR ONE IS UNAMBIGUOUS: EVERY WOMAN CHOOSES ONE PRIMARY BUILD EXPRESSION, and what used to be Fill is now handled by the specialist Pillars PLUS ADOPTED NATIVE BODILY TRAITS IN CLINIC NOTATION. THERE IS NO CORE-AND-FILL LAYERING ANY MORE.

SO EVERY fillBuild FIELD IN THIS ARCHIVE IS A RETIRED STRUCTURE SITTING ON A LIVE RECORD. Luna’s says Huntress. The ruling that confirmed her Primary Build as Ethereal is what made the second field visibly obsolete rather than merely old.

WHAT THE CONVERSION WOULD REQUIRE, AND WHY THE ARCHIVE IS NOT DOING IT: each Build holds THREE canonical Native Traits, and adoption is recorded as CLINIC ADOPTION NAME, then SOURCE BUILD and CANONICAL NATIVE TRAIT in parentheses, with an optional household nickname beneath that never replaces the entry. TO CONVERT LUNA’S HUNTRESS FILL, SOMEBODY MUST SAY WHICH OF HUNTRESS’S THREE TRAITS SHE CARRIES. A fill is one word. An adoption is a named trait with a source and a notation. THE SECOND CANNOT BE DERIVED FROM THE FIRST.

AND THERE IS A HARDER CASE UNDERNEATH THE EASY ONE. Pillar One warns that adoptions must stay LOCALLY ADDRESSED AND COMPATIBLE, and that if they displace the Primary Build’s first read, Physical Root, Stamina Shape or Movement Grammar, THE CLINIC REVISITS HER BUILD rather than giving her one government on paper and another in the mirror. A v7 Fill was HALF A WOMAN’S BODY BY DESIGN. Some of these fills may be too large to become adoptions at all, and may mean the Primary Build itself needs re-reading.

RELATED AND NARROWER: q-template records that every imported profile is v5 against a v7 template. THIS IS THE NEXT MIGRATION AFTER THAT ONE, and it is the first that DELETES a field rather than filling one. Seventy-four records, nothing guessed, flagged whole.
